[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling>=1.25"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project]
name = "salesreport"
version = "0.6.0"
description = "Sales reports from whitespace-separated exports, on pandas"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = [
    "pandas==3.0.6",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8",
]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["src/salesreport"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]

"""Reading the warehouse exports."""

import io
from typing import List

import pandas as pd

COLUMNS: List[str] = ["date", "region", "product", "units", "unit_price", "notes"]


def load_sales(text: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Rows of ``date region product units unit_price notes`` separated by whitespace, with a
    header; ``-`` marks a missing value. Adds ``revenue`` (units times unit price)."""
    frame = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(text), sep=r"\s+", parse_dates=["date"], na_values=["-"])
    missing = [column for column in COLUMNS if column not in frame.columns]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"the export lacks the columns {', '.join(missing)}")
    frame["revenue"] = frame["units"] * frame["unit_price"]
    return frame


def load_prices(text: str) -> pd.Series:
    """A ``date,price`` CSV as a Series of prices indexed by date, oldest first."""
    frame = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(text), parse_dates=["date"], index_col="date")
    return frame["price"].sort_index()

"""Picking rows out of an export."""

import pandas as pd


def flag_large_orders(frame: pd.DataFrame, threshold: float = 1000.0) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """A copy with a boolean ``large`` column: revenue above ``threshold``."""
    frame = frame.copy()
    frame["large"] = False
    frame.loc[frame["revenue"] > threshold, "large"] = True
    return frame


def select_region(frame: pd.DataFrame, region: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """One region's rows; changing the result never changes the export."""
    return frame[frame["region"] == region]


def rush_orders(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Rows whose notes mention a rush, in any case."""
    return frame[frame["notes"].str.contains("rush", case=False, na=False)]
